messages:
leah (Docs): FYI opened PR to tighten SOC2 wording on audit logs + add SDK export examples (curl -> py/js/rs). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4952
omar (Security): Thanks. Please avoid 'tenant' in public docs; prefer 'customer'. Also add note: redaction does not immediately purge from offsite backups; subject to legal holds.
leah (Docs): Draft line: "Redwood retains audit logs according to customer-defined retention settings; export and deletion requests are processed, subject to lawful holds and applicable regulations." Thoughts?
tess (Legal): Replace 'processed' with 'fulfilled' and add 'contractual obligations' after 'holds'. Final: "...requests are fulfilled, subject to lawful holds and contractual obligations."
leah (Docs): Updated in PR. Added ISO-8601 TTL examples (P30D, P90D) instead of '30 days' wording.
vik (DevEx): I'll add Python/JS/Rust snippets. Q: should we show stream+pagination or only page-based?
nav (Eng): Show both briefly. Use `format=jsonl`, `page_token` and `page_size`. Note that Export stream may reconnect on timeout.
vik (DevEx): Example py snippet I plan to add:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=TOKEN)
for chunk in client.audit.export(since='2025-06-01', format='jsonl', page_size=200):
    print(chunk)
```
leah (Docs): Also include a small redacted JSONL example so customers see schema: `\{"timestamp\":\"2025-06-02T12:00:00Z\",\"event\":\"access_grant\",\"user_id\":\"acct_7\",\"redacted\":true}`
tess (Legal): LGTM for public copy. One nit: swap 'retention settings' -> 'retention policy' in one sentence so legal readers see policy term.
leah (Docs): Done. Changed to 'retention policy' and pushed. Adding Tess as reviewer.
omar (Security): Approved from security after adding a backup & holds caveat in the export notes.
leah (Docs): Thanks everyone — merging once CI green. Will follow up with a short migration note for SDK method name changes in the changelog.
